brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit (small footprint using few bases)
requirements.evidence: Build uses 4 bases: three full at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1 forming triangular cluster, plus half base at -1,0 for drawer — total 4 cells wide, all level 0, capped and joint-bolted.
drawer:0#-1,0#cut on half-s base at -1,0,0 (north-facing cut) — provides desk storage.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 mount spike at junction of the three full bases (0,0, 0,1, 1,0)
spike accessory set to platform-lrg on mount spike, providing small display platform at that corner junction.

finish.summary: Built compact desk unit from 3 full bases in tight triangle plus a half base carrying a drawer. Mount spike with large platform at the three-base junction (0,0/0,1/1,0) as requested, with open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
